changelog:
Initial release of the Work Productivity Nano Banana Workflow Helper.

- Provides step-by-step support for Nano Banana Pro-style workflows focused on bug fixing, setup hardening, safety, reliability, and adjacent skill creation.
- Output includes tailored work plans, reusable templates, and verification notes for user requests.
- Ensures workflows are compatible with local hardware and avoid reliance on cloud-only or large-model solutions.
- Clearly documents assumptions, required inputs, and next steps for actionable and repeatable results.
